defects.effect: A visible daemon process can be treated as healthy without proving a fresh matching heartbeat.
The helper exits zero at line 109 while the queue may remain unprocessed.
A process is accepted without fresh heartbeat, queue scan or task claim evidence.
The restart receipt writes task_claimed=false and never promotes it.
Helper exit zero is mapped to recovery invoked, not proven recovery.
The operator receipt can remain local and cannot prove remote recovery.
Current operator blob differs from the blob recorded in holder and security status evidence.
Current operator script uses git reset --hard although the continuation contract forbids reset --hard during recovery.
Missing repo, Git, status or HEAD errors can throw before a recovery receipt is written.

required_holder_owner_changes: Remove reset --hard from guarded recovery and preserve dirty work safely with snapshot/stash plus an isolated recovery worktree when needed.
Write a failure receipt on every exit path, including missing repository, Git executable, status and HEAD failures.
Read the canonical daemon heartbeat and enforce a bounded freshness threshold.
When a daemon exists but heartbeat is stale, fail closed or execute the approved single-daemon recovery.
After start, require a fresh heartbeat with matching process identity and canonical branch.
Require priority-1 queue scan or claim evidence before declaring recovery successful.
Publish operator and restart receipts with commit, push and remote readback.
